name: Madeira Airport (Cristiano Ronaldo)

curfew.v: Take-off and landing banned by law 00:00–06:00 local (AIP: 00:00 (23:00)–06:00 (05:00)), except force majeure and a limited exception quota (31 daily, 80 weekly)
curfew.quote: Landing and/or take-off is forbidden by law between 00:00 (23:00) and 06:00 (05:00), except in cases of force majeure.

permits.v: Captain needs at least 200 hours as captain on type before Madeira training, recent Madeira experience, and daytime familiarity before night operations (operator training approved by ANAC)
permits.quote: A captain can operate at night provided he has previously operated and got familiar with Madeira Airport during daytime.

ppr.v: Flying club and delivery aircraft need 24 hours PPR

notes: Read NAV Portugal eAIP AD 2 LPMA (current eAIP, valid from 01 Oct 2026). Runway 05/23 length could not be read from the extracted table (only 2481 m with a footnote about 150 m pavement), so runway is left missing; customs hours were blank in the text read. Special airport: captain qualification and recent experience required, visual landings only, RWY 05 needs 5,000 m and RWY 23 7,000 m visibility, backtrack forbidden above 30 t MTOW. Slots via GEN 1.2.2. Madeira is UTC+0 in winter, so local = first time given; the bracketed times match local in summer.
